requirement: R2 Runtime and BSM shall build test deploy and persist independently
The first R2-BSM integration shall use the public SAP contract
R2 shall select another spatial provider without product-code changes
BSM shall select another mobile agent without mapping-core changes
No product shall read or write the peer product database
SAP shall negotiate compatible semantic protocol and capabilities
Public measurements shall use SI units and right-handed named frames
Time-sensitive evidence shall include UTC monotonic clock ID source and uncertainty
Pose and geometry estimates shall include provenance confidence and uncertainty
Commands shall have identity idempotency deadline preconditions and terminal result
Event delivery shall be resumable and tolerate duplicates/out-of-order delivery
Unknown additive fields shall be tolerated within a compatible version
Artifacts shall have media type size SHA-256 producer and lifecycle metadata
Arrival time shall not be substituted for measurement time
Exactly one process/module shall own the persistent R2 BLE connection
The actual R201 firmware capabilities shall be probed and recorded before automation
The driver shall expose verified drive sensors collision battery head leg LED audio and animation capabilities where supported
Disconnect/reconnect shall not resume movement
All motion shall require a bounded local lease and watchdog
Stop status quiet cancel and safe hold shall not require an LLM or internet
LLM output shall use typed high-level tools and never raw motors or leases
Expressions shall compile semantic intent deterministically into verified bounded primitives
Discovery shall use short supervised bounded segments and stop on repeated encounter or uncertainty
Patrol shall use an approved versioned route and pause on stale/degraded localization
Talk-to-Tag shall link spoken referents to events poses entities and later map features with provenance
The Safari client shall provide status deadman manual control emergency stop tags and diagnostics over HTTPS
The stock R201 charging command shall stage and request human USB connection not claim self-plugging
Pi health battery BLE collision and stuck signals shall be distinct and observable
R2 shall operate in deterministic/manual degraded mode without BSM smolagents STT email or internet
BSM shall operate with SimMobileAgent and no R2 code installed
BSM shall support simulation offline replay stationary and live-agent evidence modes
Microphone nodes shall report sample clock processing calibration and privacy state
Probe emissions shall report waveform hash actual timing gain pose and uncertainty
The signal pipeline shall preserve raw evidence and version all derived stages
Blank-slate mapping shall establish or declare origin axes scale and time gauge
An optional blueprint shall be a weighted uncertain prior not ground truth
Map revisions shall be immutable content-addressed and evidence-linked
Unknown space shall remain distinct from free space
BSM shall issue time-bounded advisories rather than motor commands
Poor clock geometry SNR or calibration shall degrade/abstain rather than publish false validity
Simulation and real-room accuracy claims shall remain separately labeled
R2 shall begin and restart stopped and never reconstruct active movement
Local stop dispatch shall meet defined P95 targets under Pi load
Real motion tests shall require explicit operator authorization preflight and bounded envelope
Operation shall follow R201 visibility keep-out temperature damage and charging constraints
Acoustic probes shall enforce calibrated gain duration repetition duty and quiet limits
Collision detection shall not be represented as guaranteed prevention
Provider loss stale transforms and lease expiry shall lead to safe hold without auto-resume
Network APIs shall authenticate authorize validate rate-limit and protect against replay
Persistent LAN devices should support TLS and mTLS with scoped credentials
Email web transcript and peer text shall be treated as untrusted non-executable data
Secrets shall remain outside source logs continuity DB and browser configuration
Microphone capture shall be local-first visibly indicated and mission/window bounded by default
Raw audio conversation and external-content retention shall be configurable and deletable
R2 and BSM shall use append-first versioned events and independently rebuildable views
Semantic entities shall retain aliases claims provenance confidence and revision history
Spatial references shall retain original frame transform/map revision and uncertainty
Backups shall be consistent and periodically restore-tested
Pi deployment shall preserve existing LAMP services and avoid implicit OS upgrades
R2 BLE/audio/core shall be host-native systemd services with atomic release rollback
Every release shall record build protocol config migrations dependencies evidence and hashes
Simulation shall be the default and hosted CI shall not reach real motors
Deterministic simulations shall record seeds and acoustic truth outside estimator input
Safety tests shall assert final stop/safe state across duplicate timeout crash reconnect and stale cases
Numerical evaluations shall report distributions failures abstentions and uncertainty coverage
